subject.title: [Feature]: Add a dropdown to select which workboard to display

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class Workboard board filter, and should its selection remain session-local or become a persisted user preference?
rationale: The issue proposes a new UI mode and optional durable state, but neither the current product roadmap nor the report selects a preference scope or establishes that persistence is needed.

options.title: Ship a view-only filter first
options.body: Add an All Boards-default selector that filters the current view only, without storing a preference until real usage demonstrates a need.

options.title: Ship a persisted preference
options.body: Add the filter and save the choice only after choosing a documented per-user ownership and reset behavior.

options.title: Defer Workboard expansion
options.body: Leave the current all-board view in place while prioritizing the roadmap’s stability and setup work.

recommendation.title: Ship a view-only filter first
recommendation.body: Add an All Boards-default selector that filters the current view only, without storing a preference until real usage demonstrates a need.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Workboard lifecycle work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for a view/state ownership decision.
